cells.title: 一行里有很大的数时，直接算 exp 会溢出
每行越长，耗时跟着变长
cells.code:
widths = [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
inputs = {w: torch.randn(4096, w, device="cuda") for w in widths}
mine = [hg.bench(lambda: softmax_hip(inputs[w]), label=f"mine-{w}").median_ms for w in widths]
base = [hg.bench(lambda: torch.softmax(inputs[w], dim=-1), label=f"torch-{w}").median_ms for w in widths]

outputs.caption: 4096 行，每行的元素数从 256 到 4096

cells.title: 多种形状都要算对
cells.code:
checks = hg.check(softmax_hip, lambda x: torch.softmax(x, dim=-1),
                  shapes=[7, (33, 1000), (1, 4096), (4096, 1024), (4096, 4096)])

cells.title: 和 torch 比耗时和带宽
cells.code:
x = torch.randn(4096, 4096, device="cuda")
result = hg.compare({"torch": lambda: torch.softmax(x, dim=-1), "mine": lambda: softmax_hip(x)},
                    bytes_moved=2 * x.numel() * 4)
